verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs say teams can assign tasks and set deadlines in-platform and claim continuous evidence collection with alerts. Its AI evidence gap analysis checks uploaded evidence for timeliness and flags outdated timestamps, which loosely touches staleness tracking. None of this is documented as a dedicated manual-evidence workflow; the explicit ownership and due-date tracking shown applies to AI-governance findings, not evidence artifacts. Missing for 10: per-artifact owners and due dates on manual evidence, renewal reminders, expiry dates or recurrence on manual artifacts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
